So what's your favorite Ozu film?

I do have Floating Weeds... I shoulf watch that this weekend.

I love Ozu and there are very few Ozu films I wouldn't recommend, but if I had to pick a favourite it would be Late Spring. Setsuko Hara's and Chishu Ryu's performances floor me every time, and I think the somewhat narrower focus on the father-daughter relationship, in contrast with e.g. Tokyo Story that focuses on the whole family unit, heightens the emotional impact of the film.

Other films I would highlight as personal favourites are A Story of Floating Weeds (1934), The Only Son (1936), The Flavour of Green Tea over Rice (1952), Tokyo Twilight (1957), and all of his colour films. The only films I wouldn't recommend are The Record of a Tenement Gentleman (1947) and some of his early silent comedies.
